verdict.rationale: ROCm docs provide official SDK support for PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, SGLang, and Llama.cpp on RX 9070 XT with install guides and Docker images, giving genuine SDK build paths for AI-native developers. missing for 10: no official REST/agentic API or OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), no independent hands-on corroboration of SDK stability on this specific card, and ROCm Windows support is newer/less mature than Linux.
